title: What the guides know about Lady Bird Lake
why: Solution-aware visitors comparing Austin options; specific, checkable guide knowledge shows why a guided tour beats paddling blind, and introduces the Skyline and All-Day tours for after bat season.
hook_options: Things only the guides seem to know
The bats live in a mistake. And four more Lady Bird Lake facts.
Zero alligators. And other things our guides get asked daily.
caption: The bats live in a construction accident. There are zero alligators. There's exactly one legal swim spot. A few things our guides get asked about Lady Bird Lake, and the tours where you hear the rest. #ladybirdlake #austintexas #thingstodoinaustin #austinkayaktours

slides.headline: Things only the guides seem to know
slides.body: We paddle this lake most days of the season. These are the details that make guests stop paddling and ask, wait, really?

slides.headline: The bats live in a mistake
slides.body: The 1980 rebuild of Congress Avenue Bridge left narrow expansion joints underneath. Accidentally perfect bat habitat.

slides.headline: Up to 1.5 million bats move in
slides.body: The biggest urban bat colony in North America roosts in those joints, right above the water you paddle.

slides.headline: Alligators on Lady Bird Lake? Zero.
slides.body: Not one of our guides has had an alligator sighting here. If that's the worry, you're thinking of the coast.

slides.headline: Turtles line up on the same logs
slides.body: Find a half-sunk log on a warm day and look closely. Guests keep writing that they saw so many turtles, ducks, fish and birds.

slides.headline: There's exactly one legal swim spot
slides.body: Swimming in Lady Bird Lake itself isn't allowed. Our all-day tour paddles up Barton Creek to the only legal swimming hole on the lake.

slides.headline: Then the water narrows
slides.body: The All Day Skyline and Swimming Hole Tour runs 5 hours with lunch, by kayak or paddleboard. Most visitors never see this part.

slides.headline: The guides are the tour
slides.body: Reviewers keep naming them. "Very knowledgeable about local area history, Lady Bird Lake, fauna around the lake and the bats."

slides.headline: The Skyline Tour is the history lesson
slides.body: Two hours at 10am, 1pm or 4pm. West side history, architecture and landmarks, told from the water. Our most popular tour.

slides.headline: Paddle with the people who know
slides.body: Skyline and sunset bat tours on Lady Bird Lake. Book at austinkayaktours.com.
